regression_contracts.immutable-reuse: 32 updates create exactly two Surface resource/Arc allocations; 131072 resource bytes for this 64x64 fixture; hide frees both. 64 groups with current+idle at 128 SRVs admit a changed size by evicting only eligible idle images.
regression_contracts.hide-close-before-submit: Another CPU invalidates/closes after command recording/Close but before Execute. Final epoch/accepting check cancels replay; current cleared target stays red; wait_idle(0) cannot claim idle while recording lease is held. A cancelled slot is reusable.
regression_contracts.unpublished-copy: A completed but unpublished blue copy cannot modify concurrently replayed green retained pixels. Confirm publishes blue; invalidating while publication is held prevents confirm from resurrecting the image.
regression_contracts.maintenance-contention: The existing retained-image WARP test now holds the real maintenance/publication mutex on another CPU while the current callback replays green into a red-cleared target. Frozen parent test.log records this test passing.
regression_contracts.sixteen-slots-and-retirement: Existing sixteen-slot GPU-pressure and copy-plus-replay retirement tests pass in parent test.log; no render-side wait-event creation is allowed.

limits: WARP controlled-pixel and lifecycle fixtures are not live-game visual or FPS acceptance.
Image resource accounting excludes driver fence, command allocator/list, and descriptor heap allocation sizes.
Normal immutable retention uses two surfaces per active group rather than the previous single surface; the existing 128 MiB/128 descriptor/64 group limits remain.
